study_type.rationale: The deposit describes an aptamer SELEX experiment with selection reads from the final selection round.

target.evidence_quote: This study identifies an aptamer that selectively binds to perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA).

target_class.evidence_quote: Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) is a toxic, bioaccumulative chemical that is present globally in water.

n_rounds.evidence_quote: After 30 rounds of selection, one candidate, Candidate 9, showed a measurable binding affinity with a kd of 2 µM and demonstrated no binding to other chemicals that are similar in terms of structure to PFOA.

counter_selection.note: The deposit states that counter-selection was added and refers to chemicals used in counter-selection.
counter_selection.evidence_quote: 2D structure analysis demonstrated an enrichment of hairpin structure, especially after the addition of counter-selection.

study_type.rationale: The deposit contains Helicase-SELEX substrate-enrichment reads rather than a standard aptamer-selection read set.
study_type.evidence_quote: We have used a global screening approach called Helicase-SELEX (see Delaleau et al., 2022, PMID: 36095194) to identify Rho helicase substrate sequences (aka Rut sequences) within the genome of Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

target.evidence_quote: In this way, only duplexes containing suitable substrate sequences were unwound by the FL or DNID Rho helicase and released in the supernatant.

target_class.evidence_quote: Helicase-SELEX mapping of Mycobacterium tuberculosis transcription terminator Rho utilization (Rut) sites

chemistry.evidence_quote: Each gDNA fragment library was converted into a library of biotinylated RNA:DNA duplexes (each containing  a ~90 to ~130 nucleotide-long ssRNA sequence of genomic origin), which were immobilized on streptavidin-coated beads and then incubated, in the presence of ATP, with either the full-length (FL) Rho helicase from M. tuberculosis or a truncated variant lacking the taxon-specific N-terminal insertion domain (DNID variant).

n_random.evidence_quote: The starting library consisted of randomly PCR-amplified gDNA fragments (~90 to ~130 bp) from the genome of M. tuberculosis reference strain H37Rv.

n_rounds.evidence_quote: After 10 rounds of this iterative enrichment process, the activity of each library towards the Rho helicase became constant and its composition was determined by NGS.
